newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Oct 21.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc hopes to make Japan's giant telecommunication company Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp its Asian partner in global telecommunications operations when the Japanese government eases regulations on the telecommunication market.

Japan Energy Corp plans to look for oil and gas in Honjo, Yamagata Prefecture from November, using seismic exploration methods. It is aiming for commercial exploitation in three to four years in the area.
NEC Corp plans to start Internet research service with Yahoo Japan Corp from October 21.

Japanese advertising company Hakuhodo is expected to post a current profit of ten billion yen in the business year ending November 30, helped by strong television and newspaper advertising sales. It is also expected to increase its sales to 655 billion yen in the same period.
